name: nginx
description: The official NGINX Open Source repository.
one_liner: The traffic cop software that sits in front of a huge share of websites, deciding how requests get routed, balanced, and cached.
buyer: Honestly, nobody starts a new business because this trended. It's decades-old, already ubiquitous, commodity infrastructure with its own commercial support arm.
business_use_cases: A DevOps consultancy sells a 'server performance and security tune-up' audit to small businesses running self-hosted sites, using nginx config as the deliverable.
A hosting reseller bundles pre-hardened nginx configs as part of a managed-hosting package for small e-commerce clients.
An agency offers a one-time 'is your site about to fall over' load-balancing review for a growing online store.

money_ideas.idea: One-off server performance/security audit and config hardening for small business sites
Managed hosting retainer that includes ongoing nginx maintenance and uptime monitoring

steal_this: Package a free 'nginx security checklist' PDF as a lead magnet to book paying server-hardening audits for small e-commerce sites.
